test_title: RRB ALP CBT-I 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 28 Nov, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In a country, 55% of the population are females. 80% of the male population is literate. What percentage of females are literate if the total literacy rate is 58%?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Using the **Alligation Method**:

Ratio of **Male** to **Female** = 45 : 55 = 9 : 11

Let Female literacy be x%.

(80 − 58) ÷ (58 − x) = 11 ÷ 9

22 ÷ (58 − x) = 11 ÷ 9 ⇒ 2 × 9 = 58 − x

18 = 58 − x ⇒ x = 40%

**∴ The correct answer is 40%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**Total Population** = 100 (Assumption)

**Females** = 55% of 100 = 55

**Males** = 100 − 55 = 45

**Total Literacy Rate** = 58% of 100 = 58

**Male Literacy Rate** = 80% of 45

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ebdb3e2152ac0765ce9eeaef4f4313d8df194fc84ba205029dfc43c551d43063.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total Literate people = 100 × (58 ÷ 100) = 58

⇒ Literate Males = 45 × (80 ÷ 100) = 36

⇒ Literate Females = Total Literates − Literate Males

⇒ Literate Females = 58 − 36 = 22

⇒ Female Literacy % = (Literate Females ÷ Total Females) × 100

⇒ Female Literacy % = (22 ÷ 55) × 100

⇒ Female Literacy % = (2 ÷ 5) × 100 = 40%

**∴ The correct answer is 40%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Weighted Average Concept

The total percentage is the weighted average of the subgroups: AverageTₒₜₐₗ = (n₁a₁ + n₂a₂) ÷ (n₁ + n₂).

Percentage to Fraction Conversion

Fractions like 2/5 = 40%, 1/5 = 20%, and 3/5 = 60% are essential for solving **data interpretation** and **percentage** problems quickly.

Base Change Property

Always identify the correct **base** (denominator). Here, literacy rate for females is calculated with respect to the total **female population**, not the total population.</p
